title: 🐶 Playful & Loving Dogs Ready for Adoption in Lewisburg, WV - NewsBreak
text:
19 hours ago Looking for a loyal friend to share your days with? The Greenbrier Humane Society in Lewisburg, WV has several wonderful dogs waiting for their forever homes. Each one has a unique personality and plenty of love to give.
Thor Breed: Terrier (Medium mix)
Age: Adult
Gender: Male
Adoption Fee: $90
Thor is a sturdy, medium-sized terrier mix who’s ready to be someone’s best buddy. He’s past the puppy stage but still full of energy and affection.
Shelter: Greenbrier Humane Society — (304) 645-4775
👉 Meet Thor and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Cinnamon Breed: Terrier (Medium mix)
Age: Young
Gender: Female
Color: Tan/Yellow/Fawn
Cinnamon is a sweet young terrier mix with a warm, golden coat. She’s eager to learn and would love a family who enjoys playtime and walks.
Shelter: Greenbrier Humane Society — (304) 645-4775
👉 Meet Cinnamon and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Sweet Pea Breed: Jack Russell Terrier / Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Young
Gender: Female
Color: White/Brown/Chocolate
Adoption Fee: $90
Sweet Pea lives up to her name! This young terrier mix is bright, friendly, and ready to bring joy to her new home.
Shelter: Greenbrier Humane Society — (304) 645-4775
👉 Meet Sweet Pea and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Daisy Breed: Dutch Shepherd / Mixed Breed (Medium)
Age: Young
Gender: Female
Color: Brindle
Daisy is a striking brindle Dutch Shepherd mix with a curious and gentle nature. She’s young and ready to grow up with a loving family.
Shelter: Greenbrier Humane Society — (304) 645-4775
👉 Meet Daisy and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Maxx Breed: Golden Retriever
Age: Baby
Gender: Male
Color: Tan/Yellow/Fawn
Maxx is a golden retriever pup with a heart as big as his paws. He’s playful, curious, and ready to learn all about life with his new family.
Shelter: Greenbrier Humane Society — (304) 645-4775
👉 Meet Maxx and apply to adopt on adoptapet
If you’re ready to open your heart and home, stop by the Greenbrier Humane Society or call (304) 645-4775 to learn more about these adoptable dogs.
Please note: Pet availability changes quickly. Some pets listed here may have already been adopted or reclaimed, and links may no longer be active. Contact the shelter directly for the most up-to-date information.
